name: cmbsiakam
caption:
YEAR 2 🎮🏀 Pascal Siakam was pick 27. Collin Murray-Boyles was pick 9. In year two, Collin is ahead.

• Siakam, year 2 (2017-18): 7.3 PPG, 4.5 RPG, 50.8 FG%
• Collin, year 2, first 9 games: 10.7 PPG, 5.0 RPG, 50.7 FG%
• Siakam, year 3: 16.9 PPG, Most Improved Player, NBA champion
• Collin made the All-Rookie Second Team in 2026

Will Collin end up better than Siakam? 👇

facts.claim: Siakam was drafted 27th overall (#27) by Toronto in 2016; 2017-18 was his year 2 and 2018-19 his year 3, when he was Most Improved Player and NBA champion (2019)
Murray-Boyles was chosen ninth overall (#9, pick 9) by Toronto in the 2025 draft; 2026-27 is his year 2; NBA All-Rookie Second Team (2026)
